name: OpenBB Dev Container - Optimized
postCreateCommand: apt-get update && apt-get install -y git gnupg && echo 'source /tmp/codespace_env_exports' >> /root/.bashrc
postStartCommand: git config --global user.name "$GIT_USER_NAME" && git config --global user.email "$GIT_USER_EMAIL" && chmod +x .devcontainer/populate_env.py && python3 .devcontainer/populate_env.py > /tmp/codespace_env_exports && cp /tmp/codespace_env_exports .env && echo '--- /tmp/codespace_env_exports contents ---' && cat /tmp/codespace_env_exports && echo '--- End of env file ---'
